steps.title: Distribute buffer with p300
steps.instruction: Use the p300 single‑channel pipette to dispense buffer from the 12‑well reservoir into the specified wells of up to three 96‑well child plates, following the volumes, plate locations, and well locations provided in the uploaded CSV file.

steps.title: Transfer parent contents
steps.instruction: Using either a p20 single‑channel or the p300 single‑channel pipette, transfer the contents from the specified wells of up to three 96‑well parent plates into the corresponding wells of the child plates, then mix, according to the plate locations, well locations, and volumes listed in the uploaded CSV file.
